title: Calendar System
description: A dating system (Gregorian, Julian, Hijri, Nengō, Buddhist Era, etc.).

epoch_year.description: Proleptic Gregorian year of year 1. Negative = BCE. null = no fixed epoch (pure regnal).

gregorian_offset.description: gregorian_year = calendar_year + gregorian_offset. Used for simple solar calendars.

formula.description: Textual/pseudocode formula for non-linear conversions (Hijri lunar drift, Ethiopian, etc.).

approximate.description: True when the conversion is inherently approximate (e.g. lunar-to-solar drift). UI should show a ~ prefix.

named_years.description: Named year sequences within this calendar (all Japanese nengō, all Chinese regnal era names, etc.).

id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'japanese-nengo.meiji'. Optional; recommended for calendars with entity cross-refs.

entity_id.description: Deprecated single-value entity link. Prefer entity_ids for many-to-many linking.

entity_ids.description: Entities associated with this named year (Period, Reign, and/or Event nodes).
